title: Task 5: Add module rules requirements and neutral encounter refs
description:
Objective:
Make module packs declare compatible rules requirements and stop hardcoding `srdRef` as the public module-to-rules seam.

Files:
- Modify: `packages/core/src/world/types.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/world/validate.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/world/forkCampaign.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/world/samples/emberfallHollow.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/campaign.ts`
- Test: `packages/core/test/world.test.ts`
- Test: `packages/core/test/campaignRulesBinding.test.ts`

Steps:
1. Write failing world tests for required `meta.rulesRequirements`, provider-neutral encounter creature `rulesRef`, and rejection when `rulesRequirements.baseSystemId` is missing.
2. Write a failing campaign test that creating a campaign with a Pathfinder binding and the D&D Emberfall module rejects before module rows are forked.
3. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/world.test.ts packages/core/test/campaignRulesBinding.test.ts`; expected: FAIL.
4. Add `ModuleRulesRequirements` to module meta and validation.
5. Rename or dual-read encounter creature refs from `srdRef` to `rulesRef`; preserve read compatibility only if needed by existing tests.
6. Update `EMBERFALL_HOLLOW` to require D&D SRD and use `rulesRef` values.
7. In `createCampaign`, validate module requirements against the selected campaign rules binding before `forkModuleIntoCampaign`.
8. Run focused tests; expected: PASS.
9. Commit with `git add packages/core/src/world packages/core/src/campaign.ts packages/core/test/world.test.ts packages/core/test/campaignRulesBinding.test.ts` and `git commit -m feat-validate-module-rules-requirements`.
acceptance_criteria: World and campaign focused tests pass. Module packs declare rules requirements. Campaign creation rejects incompatible module/rules pairings. Encounter creature refs are provider-neutral.
close_reason: Module packs now require meta.rulesRequirements (baseSystemId + optional version/addon constraints); EncounterCreature.srdRef renamed to provider-neutral rulesRef and Emberfall updated accordingly; createCampaign rejects bindings incompatible with the module before forking; docs/world.md refreshed. Verified: focused world + campaignRulesBinding tests pass (34/34), full npm run typecheck and npm run test pass (372 passed, 2 documented skips).
